title: Galehigh Terraces - Skyborne
_note: Option C diegetic/relit variant. era gba (8 voices, chords allowed, some reverb) - the richer register the brief reserves for the relit Storm constellation. Radiant D major, Lydian-tinged G#. Voices: bright pulse25 lead with wide soaring intervals; a second airy triangle counter-lead trading the hook; shimmering pulse12 arp; a sustained pad (real chord, gba-only) for the 'lift'; tri_bass driving; drums + a wide aurora-adjacent noise swoosh (ohat/crash) as the updraft catches. Vesper SOARING transform: rising leap WIDENED to a sixth/octave (A4->D5->B5...), the line floats up before its settle - the motif taking flight. 24-bar loop; final bar lands on A (dominant) -> floats back into the bar-1 lift. 6 voices peak, within the 8 budget; clarity over count.
